purpose: Independent analytical references for T4-U6 (D-5 section bases) and the Timoshenko variant shared with T4-U8: one straight pipe, frozen before any product implementation; not product requests and not observed solver outputs.
status: frozen by the T4-U6/T4-U8 independent reference TASK and refuted independently; the refutation's four findings were repaired in 6817b72ca9 without a value change, and an independent refuter confirmed all four repairs on 2026-10-16. An independent refuter also confirmed the three later changes on 2026-10-16: (a) the primitive-load id repair a2d3f27020 (every primitive-load id names its load case; U6-BASES-001-EB, U6-BASES-001-TIMO and U6-BASES-COINCIDENT had reused their tip load ids in case:pressure-tip and case:axial-tip, which the product refuses as DUPLICATE_ID) is id-only: reverting the new ids gives the old request bytes exactly, and oracle.json changed only in its status and six request sha256 bindings; (b) U6-BASES-002-TIMO (2621c1c783), which binds U6-BASES-002's frozen rows to a timoshenko_annulus_energy_v1 request, repeats the euler_bernoulli variant's rows, zero scales, evidence rows and 17 discriminators, and the case is shear-model independent (both nodes fully anchored, axial loads only); (c) the two generated-self-weight requests (request_self_weight) are faithful to the frozen case:self-weight and case:combined definitions (densities, metal on the nominal wall, contents on the pressure bore, the authored binary64 order), and an independent recomputation of the support reactions, node B u_z and r_y, and root V_z and M_y matches the frozen rows to within 1.5e-40 relative. No primitive-load id is duplicated in any request

basis.design: DEL-05-03 Design section-bases-and-timoshenko.md sections 1, 2.1, 2.5, 3.1, 7 and 8, and section-and-shear-decisions.md (D-5, H4), at b3f4da7661
basis.shear: SHEAR_REFERENCE CONTRACT.md sections 1, 3 and 4 and its reference arithmetic (archive f2211ecef6)
basis.conventions: validation/references/t4_i8 (the repaired T4-I8 freeze, 5b07d85cf3): row shape, stations, signs, criteria
basis.independence: no product code, test or output was read or run

numbers: Invented test quantities; decimal inputs are exact rational targets (the 1e-9 criterion absorbs their binary64 rounding); no material-library, component or code-rule data.

kinds: symbolic: a square root of a pi_polynomial, alone or added to one (support norms, member maxima), with evaluation
numeric_representation.value: binary64 rounding of the exact value

d5.nominal_section: wall t: stiffness A, I, J (and the Timoshenko shear area), pipe metal mass, the As of eps_p = (1-2nu) pAi/(E As), nominal-basis stresses
d5.reduced_section: wall t_r = (t - c_m) - c_a: reduced-basis stresses
d5.pressure_bore: r_i,r = OD/2 - t_r: Ai for the caps and the Poisson pair, contents mass
d5.each_section: As = pi w (OD - w); I = As (ro^2 + ri^2)/4; J = 2I; Z = I/ro with its own wall w and ri
d5.stresses: per basis b: sigma = N/A_b (Nw/A_b on pressurized members), M_y/Z_b, M_z/Z_b, T ro/J_b; Lame of b's own annulus: radial -p and 0, hoop 2p pi r_i,b^2/A_b at ro and that plus p at r_i,b; maximum max |N/A_b| + hypot(M_y, M_z)/Z_b
d5.kappa_E: Design section 3.1 from the nominal annulus: m = r_i,n/r_o; D = c (1-m^2)^2 + 48 m^2 (1+nu)^2, c = (8nu+14)nu+7; kappa = 6 (1+nu)^2 (1+m^2)^2/D; A_s = kappa A_n; Ks = G A_s, G = E/(2(1+nu))

sign_conventions.frame: local x = global X (A -> B), y_reference (0,1,0): local y = global Y, local z = global Z
sign_conventions.stations: end_i, quarter_1, midspan, quarter_3, end_j at 0, 1/4, 1/2, 3/4, 1 of L
sign_conventions.end_rows: element_local_* force and moment rows and pipe_wall_endpoint_action_v2 at end_i and end_j are node-on-element: end_i = -(j-side cut at 0), end_j = +(cut at L)
sign_conventions.station_rows: the j-side section action (the action of the part beyond the cut, about the cut point)
sign_conventions.stress_rows: from the j-side section action at all five locations, ends included; element_local stresses in MPa (reference in Pa)
sign_conventions.supports: support-on-pipe, global; moment about the attached node; magnitudes are the force and moment norms
sign_conventions.displacements: global; translations in mm (reference in m), right-hand rotations in rad; a Timoshenko member's rotations are section rotations

row_identity: (kind, entity_ref, component, location) plus section_basis on every stress row (nominal_section or reduced_section; Design section 2.5); basis_ref names the load case

criteria.zero: |observed| <= 1e-9 |zero_scale| in the row unit (criterion.absolute_tolerance, precomputed); the zero scales are per load case and family (force, moment, length, rotation, and stress per basis)
criteria.negative: each listed discriminator row: |observed - wrong| > max(absolute_tolerance, 1e-9 max(|observed|, |wrong|)); every listed row lies >= 1e3 tolerances from the reference
criteria.modes: both solver modes, the same reference

inferred_identities: element_local_axial_force/axial_force and element_local_axial_normal_stress/axial_normal_stress (case:axial-tip, a member outside every pressure region) follow the sibling kinds' pattern; their exact component spelling and published locations were not readable without product files (README, open items)

binary64_order.order: t_r = (t - c_m) - c_a, then r_i,r = OD/2 - t_r; r_i,n = OD/2 - t (Design section 1)
t_r = (t - c_m) - c_a, then r_i,r = OD/2 - t_r; r_i,n = OD/2 - t (Design section 1)

U6-BASES-001.description: A pressurized straight cantilever (anchored at A, free at B, L = 2 m) with mill tolerance 0.00125 m and corrosion allowance 0.002 m on OD 0.2 m, wall 0.01 m: the same model on each basis. Displacements on the nominal stiffness; reactions; the pressure thrust on the pressure bore; every stress row on the nominal and the reduced section with per-basis maxima. Euler-Bernoulli and Timoshenko (timoshenko_annulus_energy_v1, kappa_E from the nominal annulus) documents. The self-weight load cases are in a second request per variant, whose section carries the pipe metal and contents densities and whose load cases carry the generated self-weight.
